summary: In a live Code Conference interview with The Verge's Alex Heath (published on Decoder), Roblox CEO David Baszucki explains the company's push to become a billion-daily-user immersive 3D communication platform rather than just a gaming company. He covers PlayStation support, the fastest-growing 17-24 user segment, advertising and brand experiences, China via Tencent, VR/AR, and three layers of AI. An audience Q&A touches on fashion, the metaverse label, AAA gaming, and interoperability.
one_line: Roblox CEO David Baszucki tells The Verge's Code Conference that Roblox aims for a billion daily users as an immersive 3D communication platform, with AI, ads, and older users.
key_facts: Roblox's stated goal is to reach a billion daily active people on the platform, and Baszucki frames it as the next step in communication after mail, telegraph, phone, and video.
The fastest-growing user segment on Roblox is ages 17 to 24, growing north of 33 percent year on year, so the company has stopped using the term "aging up".
Roblox users generate north of 5 billion hours of engagement per month, and more of it comes from users over 17.
Roblox has never done layoffs; in Q1 2023 headcount was growing 50 percent a year, and Baszucki says bookings will grow faster than headcount next year.
Roblox is being rolled out on PlayStation, which Baszucki says is an immediate business expansion for creators whose existing creations will work there.
Tencent remains Roblox's partner in China; Roblox is building an "autonomous network" so it can "print a copy of Roblox in China", and Baszucki says the company hasn't given up on China.
Roblox described three AI clouds: about 70 AI pipelines for safety, translation, moderation and efficiency; generative AI for creation; and a far-off virtual doppelganger.
Roblox has already shipped AI code generation and AI material generation to help creators.
Baszucki says hundreds of brands are on the platform, citing a Gucci runway-show simulation and Vans World, which made younger people want to enter a Vans store in Santa Monica.
Roblox is on Meta Quest, where it got 1 million installs in five days in beta; Baszucki has not tried the Vision Pro and says Roblox is not predicting hardware growth.
Baszucki says Roblox has "nothing near a bull's-eye on AAA gaming" and focuses on performance on midrange and low-end devices such as midrange Android phones.
Baszucki says Roblox doesn't use the word metaverse much and sees itself as a communication and connection platform; he also predicts a safe 17-and-up dating app will be built on Roblox.
